footnotes: Arm is a foreign private issuer and files Form 20-F, not a 10-K; figures are in US dollars from its fiscal Q4 2026 results. Fiscal 2025 included a $72M tax benefit and $237M of equity-investment losses.
Free cash flow = operating cash flow − purchases of property and equipment (calculated; Arm's reported non-GAAP free cash flow was $882M). Arm has no debt.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Arm's revenue grew 22.8% to $4.9B in fiscal 2026 (ended March 31, 2026). Royalties from chips using Arm designs made up 53% of revenue, and licensing brought in $2.3B. Gross margin stays near 98% because Arm sells designs, not chips.
Heavy R&D spending, up 34.0% as Arm develops its own compute designs, held operating income to $900M, up 8.3%. Net income rose 14.1% to $904M, and operating cash flow jumped to $1.5B.
highlights: Operating cash flow rose 3.8 times to $1.5B.
Arm has no debt and $3.6B of cash.
watch: R&D rose 34.0%, squeezing operating margin to 18.3%.
SoftBank controls most of the shares.
